One episode updated every Monday and Friday at 10:00 Lingwu Continent is a world where spiritual power and martial souls coexist. A single thought of spiritual practice moves mountains and rivers, and warriors tear apart the world with their bare hands. Chen Tian, the former genius of Xingchen Town, lost his martial spirit and dried up his spiritual sea after he was ten years old. Since then, he has become a waste of the family and has been looked down upon by others. During a life-and-death struggle, Chen Tian fell off a cliff and accidentally entered the formation set up by the ancient sword emperor. Under the influence of the power of the Heavenly Book, he awakened his spiritual and martial physique. At the same time, he also received a strange memory and a mysterious storage item. The ring has risen from adversity, broken the reincarnation of the Heavenly Dao Palm, finally overcome the shackles of the Emperor’s Tribulation, and aspired to the Lingwu Continent!
